statement: A targeted challenge search did not contradict the assessment: the closest work reports size-matching only between the two disease KGs (not between the KG-grounded and CG-grounded training arms), uses a fixed seed only for the option-shuffling stress test rather than for seed-level variance over training runs, and its text-searchable evaluation description contains no untouched held-out test set that the repair loop cannot edit. Distinctions (i), (ii) and (iv) therefore remain unaddressed in the retrieved literature rather than being already covered by the closest work.

evidence.quote: Since the original diabetes KG is much larger than the gastroparesis KG, we construct a size-matched diabetes subset to enable a fair comparison between the two disease settings.
We apply an option-shuffling stress test in which all four answer-option texts are randomly reassigned to option labels A-D under a fixed seed, while the question stem remains unchanged.
